mainComparison.fixedDegree: Δ ≥ 3 is a constant independent of n.
mainComparison.randomizedGreedyReuse: The deterministic O(log* n) algorithm is also a randomized-model upper bound with probability 1.
mainComparison.lowerReuse: One lower-bound record contains two distinct model statements; separate visual markers preserve its original ID.

multigraphLowerDerivation: For integer Δ≥3, ⌊3Δ/2⌋≤2Δ−2. A coloring with fewer colors is also a (2Δ−2)-coloring, and simple trees belong to the loopless multigraph class. The fixed-degree deterministic Ω(log n) and randomized Ω(log log n) lower bounds therefore apply to this facet. This derivation does not claim a matching upper bound.
userSetupChoice: Bounded degree as the main view; variable-degree formulas secondary; multigraphs separate.
